# #130 Returns & Exchanges Management (`returns-and-exchanges-management`) — Scope of Work (SOW)

- **App Number & Name:** `#130` — Returns & Exchanges Management
- **Proposed App Key:** `returns-and-exchanges-management`
- **Suite / Domain Key & Model Prefix:** `COM` (`Com*`)
- **Function Category:** 13. E-Commerce & Retail
- **Representative Product (`P1`):** Loop Returns
- **Combined Feature Catalog:** [../combined-features/130-returns-and-exchanges-management-features.md](../combined-features/130-returns-and-exchanges-management-features.md)
- **Target Release Posture:** Exchange-First Self-Serve RMA Portal, Shop-Now Catalog Exchanges, Instant Card-Hold Swaps, BORIS/QR Drop-Off, Dock Inspection Grading & Refund Governance Microapplication

---

## 1. Executive Outcome & Target Audience

### 1.1 Business Problem Solved
E-commerce return rates routinely reach 15%–30% in apparel, footwear, and consumer goods—destroying gross margins when every return defaults to a full cash refund, manual email RMA back-and-forth, wasted reverse postage on low-value damaged items, slow dock restocking, or wardrobing/empty-box return fraud. **Rapider Returns & Exchanges Management (`returns-and-exchanges-management`)** turns post-purchase returns into a profit-preserving retention loop—deflecting cash refunds into 1-click variant swaps, *Shop Now* catalog upsells, and Bonus Store Credit while enforcing enterprise dock inspection grading (`Grade A/B`, `Refurbish`, `RTV`, `Scrap`) across Rapider's `ordermanagement`, `inventory`, `warehouse`, `#127` shipping, `#129` loyalty, and `FIN` suites.

### 1.2 Target Personas & Progressive Disclosure
- **SME Fast-Path Defaults (DTC Founders, Support Leads):** Activate a 30-day delivery-anchored self-serve return portal in minutes with free 1-click size/color exchanges, `+\$10.00` Bonus Store Credit over cash refunds, `\$8.00` cash-refund label fee deduction, automatic pay-on-scan return labels via `#127`, and instant restock upon warehouse scan.
- **Enterprise Progressive Disclosure (VP Reverse Logistics, Retail Store Ops, Corporate Controllers):** Unlock card-hold Instant Exchanges, BORIS (Buy Online, Return In Store) POS counter intake, Keep-Item green thresholds, serialized item verification, formal multi-grade dock inspection (`ComReturnInspection`) routing to outlet/refurbish/RTV vendor claims, and serial-returner wardrobing fraud quarantine via Home `WorkItem`s.

### 1.3 Measurable Business Outcomes
- **35%–50% Refund-to-Exchange Revenue Retention:** Variant swaps, *Shop Now* catalog browsing with upsell capture, and Bonus Store Credit convert nearly half of potential cash outflows into retained or expanded GMV.
- **< 24-Hour Dock-to-ATP Restock Cycle:** Barcode RMA grading immediately generates `OpsWarehouseTask` putaways so `Grade A` seasonal inventory returns to sellable ATP before markdown cycles hit.
- **Zero Uninspected High-Risk Cash Leakage:** Dynamic risk gating forces `ON_WAREHOUSE_INSPECTION_PASS` for high-value/high-returner orders and verifies outbound vs. inbound serial numbers.

### 1.4 Benchmark Summary (`P1`–`P6`)
Synthesizes the *Shop Now* catalog exchanges, Bonus Store Credit, Instant Exchanges, and Keep-Item economics of **`P1` Loop Returns**, boxless QR drop-off and behavioral fraud scoring of **`P2` Happy Returns**, BORIS and smart DC routing of **`P3` Narvar Returns**, flexible policy/gift/photo rules of **`P4` ReturnGO**, industrial `Grade A/B/Refurbish/RTV/Scrap` disposition rigor of **`P5` SAP Advanced Returns Management**, and closed-loop RMA-to-Credit-Memo financial governance of **`P6` Oracle NetSuite RMA & Odoo Reverse Logistics**.

## 2. In-Scope, Out-of-Scope & Suite Ownership Boundaries

### 2.1 In-Scope Capabilities
1. Delivery-anchored return policies (`ComReturnPolicy`) governing standard/VIP/holiday windows, `FINAL_SALE` blocks, label/restocking fee waivers, Keep-Item economic thresholds, and settlement triggers (`ON_FIRST_CARRIER_SCAN`, `ON_BORIS_COUNTER_CHECK`, `ON_WAREHOUSE_INSPECTION_PASS`).
2. Self-serve customer RMA, blind gift return, CS-assisted (`SupTicket`), and `#126` marketplace return intake (`ComReturnRequest`, `ComReturnLine`) with structured reason/sub-reason taxonomy and defect photo proof.
3. Exchange-first settlement engine (`ComExchangeSettlement`): 1-click sibling `ComVariant` swaps, *Shop Now* catalog-wide exchanges with upsell `FinPaymentIntent` capture, Bonus Store Credit issuance, and card-hold Instant Exchanges.
4. Pay-on-scan return shipping labels & printerless QR drop-off codes (`#127`), BORIS retail `pos` counter intake, and smart return-warehouse routing.
5. Warehouse dock barcode RMA receiving and condition grading (`ComReturnInspection`) triggering automated `OpsWarehouseTask` putaway, `MfgQualityInspection` refurbishment, or supplier RTV tracking (`ComVendorReturnClaim`).
6. Exact `Decimal128` pro-rata discount/tax/fee refund math issuing `FinInvoice` credit memos, `FinPaymentIntent` refunds, and `#129` loyalty point clawback vs. even-exchange preservation events.

### 2.2 Out-of-Scope Capabilities (Delegated to Adjacent Rapider Apps)
- **Carrier contract credentials, ZPL postage label rendering, and webhook parcel tracking:** Owned by `#127 Shipping Label & Fulfillment Management` (`shipping-label-and-fulfillment-management`).
- **Physical warehouse bin ledgers and outbound replacement order picking/packing:** Owned by `inventory` (`OpsInventoryPosition`), `warehouse` (`OpsWarehouseTask`), and `ordermanagement` (`OpsCustomerOrder`).
- **Payment gateway tokenization, card auth holds, and bank refund rails:** Owned by `payments` (`FinPaymentIntent`) and `billing` (`FinInvoice`).
- **Loyalty point sub-ledger balances and VIP tier qualification:** Owned by `#129 Customer Loyalty & Rewards` (`customer-loyalty-and-rewards`).
- **Product repair BOMs and shop-floor rework execution:** Owned by `quality` and `maintenance` (`MFG` suite).

### 2.3 Cross-Suite Ownership & Integration Contract

## 5. Core End-to-End User Journeys (6 Journeys)

### Journey 1: *Shop Now* Catalog Exchange with Upsell Capture & Bonus Credit
1. Shopper opens the branded portal (`#/portal`), enters Order `ORD-77120`, selects a `\$90.00` Linen Shirt (`SIZE_TOO_SMALL`), and sees `#128` fit consensus (*"Runs slightly slim—82% kept one size up"*).
2. Instead of a `\$82.00` cash refund (`-\$8.00` label fee), the portal offers **Free Size Swap** OR **`\$100.00` Shop Now Credit (`+\$10.00` Bonus Credit)**. Shopper browses the catalog, selects a `\$125.00` Cashmere Sweater, pays the `\$25.00` upsell via `FinPaymentIntent`, and receives a printerless QR drop-off code from `#127`.
3. Once carrier scans the return (`IN_TRANSIT`), replacement `OpsCustomerOrder` releases for fulfillment and `#129` preserves loyalty points intact (`com.returns.exchange_completed`).

### Journey 2: Instant Exchange with Temporary Card Hold & Auto-Release
1. Shopper selects **Instant Exchange** on a `\$160.00` pair of running shoes needed before a weekend race.
2. `#130` places a `\$160.00` temporary `FinPaymentIntent` authorization hold (`INSTANT_HOLD_ACTIVE`, `14-day` drop-off clock) and dispatches the replacement `OpsCustomerOrder` immediately today.
3. Three days later, `#127` ingests the first carrier scan (`IN_TRANSIT`) on the return label—automatically voiding/releasing the `\$160.00` card hold and notifying the shopper via `email`.

### Journey 3: Keep-Item Green Rule on Low-Value Damaged Mug
1. Verified loyal buyer uploads a photo of a cracked `\$14.00` ceramic mug (`ARRIVED_DAMAGED`).
2. `ComReturnPolicy` evaluates `\$7.80` return shipping + `\$4.50` warehouse grading (`\$12.30`) against `\$0.00` salvage value (`keepItemMaxValueAmount = \$20.00`), sets `dropOffMethod = KEEP_ITEM_NO_SHIP`, dispatches a free replacement immediately, and saves reverse freight cost and carbon.

### Journey 4: Warehouse Dock Barcode Grading -> ATP Restock vs. RTV Claim
1. Dock Operator at `#/dock-inspection` scans incoming return parcel barcode, opening `RMA-2026-4402` (2 items).
2. Item 1 (Unworn Coat with tags) is graded `GRADE_A_SELLABLE`, immediately creating an `OpsWarehouseTask` putaway to sellable `OpsInventoryPosition`. Item 2 (Faulty Espresso Grinder) is graded `RETURN_TO_VENDOR_RTV`, quarantining stock out of ATP and adding the unit to `ComVendorReturnClaim` against `OpsSupplierProfile`.

### Journey 5: Serial Mismatch / Empty-Box Fraud Quarantine via Home `WorkItem`
1. High-value headphones (`\$349.00`, expected serial `SN-884920A`) arrive at `#/dock-inspection` containing an old broken unit with mismatched serial `SN-110029X` (`serialMatched = false`, `WRONG_EMPTY_BOX_FRAUD`).
2. System immediately blocks the `ON_WAREHOUSE_INSPECTION_PASS` cash refund (`BLOCKED_FRAUD`), attaches high-res dock inspection photos, and raises a Rapider Home `WorkItem` for Loss Prevention review.

### Journey 6: BORIS In-Store Counter Return & Click-Through Filter Restoration
1. Store Associate at `#/boris-intake` scans customer's mobile QR code (or searches via `<rapider-phone-input>`), verifies unworn condition at the counter, absorbs the item into store inventory, and triggers instant exchange/refund.
2. Back-office supervisor filters `#/rmas` by `Status: "DISPUTED_FRAUD_HOLD"` (`#activeFilterTagsBar`), clicks `RMA-2026-4419` -> `#/rma-detail`, inspects dock evidence, and clicks `Back to RMAs` with filter tags preserved.

## 8. Technical APIs, Guarded Commands, Events & `requiredWorkflows`

### 8.1 Guarded Domain Commands
All commands enforce `idempotencyKey`, `correlationId`, and `expectedVersion`:
- `com.returns.authorizeReturnRequest` — Validates delivery window (`#127`), remaining line returnable qty, and policy eligibility; mints `#127` return label/QR or applies Keep-Item rule.
- `com.returns.initiateInstantExchange` — Places `FinPaymentIntent` card hold and releases replacement `OpsCustomerOrder`.
- `com.returns.recordDockInspection` — Logs `ComReturnInspection`, validates serial match, dispatches `OpsWarehouseTask` / `MfgQualityInspection`, and triggers eligible settlement.
- `com.returns.executeSettlement` — Computes exact `Decimal128` pro-rata refund/credit/upsell, creates `FinInvoice` credit memo / `ComStoreCreditVoucher`, and prevents duplicate cash disbursements.

### 8.2 Domain Events Published & Consumed (Kafka)
- **Published:** `com.returns.rma_authorized`, `com.returns.instant_exchange_dispatched`, `com.returns.item_inspected`, `com.returns.refund_processed` (consumed by `#129`, `#126`, `FIN`), `com.returns.exchange_completed` (consumed by `#129`), `com.returns.fraud_hold_raised`.
- **Consumed:** `com.shipment.delivered` / `com.shipment.in_transit` (`#127`), `ops.order.fulfilled` (`ordermanagement`), `com.marketplace.return_notified` (`#126`), `fin.payment.hold_authorized` (`payments`).

### 8.3 `requiredWorkflows` (Declared in `app.manifest.json`)
1. `wf-returns-carrier-scan-listener` — Listens to `#127` return `IN_TRANSIT` scans to release Instant-Exchange card holds and trigger `ON_FIRST_CARRIER_SCAN` VIP exchanges/credits.
2. `wf-returns-instant-hold-deadline-watchdog` — Sends `3-day` drop-off warning reminders via `MKT` and captures overdue `FinPaymentIntent` holds at `instantHoldDeadlineAt`.
3. `wf-returns-inspection-to-disposition` — Routes `ComReturnInspection` outcomes to `OpsWarehouseTask` putaway, `MfgQualityInspection` repair, `ComVendorReturnClaim` RTV, or Loss Prevention Home `WorkItem`s.
4. `wf-returns-financial-and-loyalty-sync` — Orchestrates idempotent `FinInvoice` credit memo + `FinPaymentIntent` refund + `#129` loyalty balance adjustment.

### 8.4 Grounded Rapider AI Governance
- AI exchange size recommendations strictly cite aggregated `#128` `ComProductRatingSummary` fit distributions and `ComProduct` size charts—never inventing garment measurements.
- AI photo-triage flags anomalies only for human moderator review (`WorkItem`) and **never** automatically denies a consumer's statutory refund right or charges an Instant-Exchange card hold without deterministic scan/deadline proof.

## 9. Security, Privacy, Compliance & Non-Functional Requirements

- **Statutory Consumer Withdrawal Compliance (EU/UK 14-Day Right of Withdrawal, Regional Laws):** Policy engine enforces statutory cooling-off periods where mandatory full refunds (without unlawful restocking fees) apply by buyer jurisdiction.
- **Blind Gift Privacy & PCI Scope Isolation:** Gift return flows strictly mask original purchaser billing details, discounts, and card digits; zero raw card PANs touch `#130` (all Instant-Exchange holds and upsell charges run via tokenized `FinPaymentIntent` in `payments`).
- **Financial Conservation & Audit Retention:** Pro-rata `Decimal128` settlement math guarantees cumulative cash refunds across partial returns never exceed original captured cash; RMA, dock photos, and credit memo links are retained for 7 years.
- **Accessibility & Responsive UX:** WCAG 2.2 AA compliant shopper portal and high-contrast warehouse/BORIS touchscreens (`#ffffff !important` primary/danger buttons) responsive across `390px` handheld scanners/phones, `768px` POS tablets, and `1440px` desktops.

---

## 10. Deterministic Acceptance Criteria (14 Testable Criteria)

1. **Sidebar Section Threshold:** All 3 visible sidebar sections (`Returns & Exchanges`, `Warehouse & Fraud`, `Policies & Insights`) contain >= 3 visible items (`3, 3, 3`), while `rma-detail`, `inspection-detail`, and `settlement-detail` set `displayOnMenu: false`.
2. **SWR & Clean Query Compliance:** Every page mount uses `findSWR` / `countSWR` without manual `isDeleted` filter clauses and filters `item.isDeleted !== true` defensively in memory.
3. **Active Filter Tags & Clear All:** Searching or filtering on `rmas`, `settlements-and-credits`, `fraud-and-claims`, `policies`, or `sku-return-analytics` displays `#activeFilterTagsBar` with escaped chips and working `Clear all`.
4. **Table Action & Click-Through Standard:** Zero `View` buttons exist in `Actions`; RMA `#`, Inspection `#`, and Settlement `#` navigate to detail views and `Back` restores filter state; row actions use icon+text `Edit` and icon-only `Delete`.
5. **Drawer Lifecycle & `finally` Reset:** Saving/cancelling RMA, policy, inspection, or RTV drawers auto-closes the container, resets button state in `finally`, invalidates SWR caches, and updates UI state optimistically.
6. **Over-Return Quantity Prevention:** Attempting to return `2` units on an order line of `2` where `1` unit already has an active `ComReturnLine` deterministically fails validation (`MAX_RETURNABLE_QTY_EXCEEDED`).
7. **Pro-Rata Cash Conservation & Non-Cash Bonus Guard:** Refunding an item bought with a cart discount refunds exact `Decimal128` net paid cash; `ComStoreCreditVoucher.bonusIncentiveAmount` can never be converted into a cash refund on a subsequent return.
8. **Instant Exchange Card-Hold Release on Scan:** Ingesting a `#127` return `IN_TRANSIT` event on an `INSTANT_HOLD_ACTIVE` settlement deterministically releases the `FinPaymentIntent` hold before `instantHoldDeadlineAt`.
9. **Serial Mismatch Fraud Quarantine:** Recording a `ComReturnInspection` with `serialMatched = false` or `WRONG_EMPTY_BOX_FRAUD` transitions `ComExchangeSettlement` to `BLOCKED_FRAUD` and creates a Rapider Home `WorkItem`.

11. **Loyalty Refund vs. Exchange Event Parity:** Cash refunds emit `com.returns.refund_processed` (triggering `#129` point clawback), while even swaps emit `com.returns.exchange_completed` (zero point clawback).
12. **Custom Elements & Dialog Ban:** `<rapider-kanban>` powers the RMA lifecycle board, `<rapider-phone-input>` handles portal/BORIS phone lookup, primary/danger buttons enforce `#ffffff !important` white text, and zero `window.alert`/`confirm`/`prompt` calls exist.
13. **Dark & Light Theme Fidelity:** All 12 pages pass `validate_theme` contrast checks in dark and light themes.
14. **6-Pillar E2E Expectations Coverage:** `e2e/expectations.json` verifies all clickable actions, `findSWR`/`countSWR` reads, click-through routes, theme validation, mutation payloads, and zero runtime errors.

## 5. Core End-to-End User Journeys (6 Journeys)

### Journey 1: *Shop Now* Catalog Exchange with Upsell Capture & Bonus Credit
1. Shopper opens the branded portal (`#/portal`), enters Order `ORD-77120`, selects a `\$90.00` Linen Shirt (`SIZE_TOO_SMALL`), and sees `#128` fit consensus (*"Runs slightly slim—82% kept one size up"*).
2. Instead of a `\$82.00` cash refund (`-\$8.00` label fee), the portal offers **Free Size Swap** OR **`\$100.00` Shop Now Credit (`+\$10.00` Bonus Credit)**. Shopper browses the catalog, selects a `\$125.00` Cashmere Sweater, pays the `\$25.00` upsell via `FinPaymentIntent`, and receives a printerless QR drop-off code from `#127`.
3. Once carrier scans the return (`IN_TRANSIT`), replacement `OpsCustomerOrder` releases for fulfillment and `#129` preserves loyalty points intact (`com.returns.exchange_completed`).

### Journey 2: Instant Exchange with Temporary Card Hold & Auto-Release
1. Shopper selects **Instant Exchange** on a `\$160.00` pair of running shoes needed before a weekend race.
2. `#130` places a `\$160.00` temporary `FinPaymentIntent` authorization hold (`INSTANT_HOLD_ACTIVE`, `14-day` drop-off clock) and dispatches the replacement `OpsCustomerOrder` immediately today.
3. Three days later, `#127` ingests the first carrier scan (`IN_TRANSIT`) on the return label—automatically voiding/releasing the `\$160.00` card hold and notifying the shopper via `email`.

### Journey 3: Keep-Item Green Rule on Low-Value Damaged Mug
1. Verified loyal buyer uploads a photo of a cracked `\$14.00` ceramic mug (`ARRIVED_DAMAGED`).
2. `ComReturnPolicy` evaluates `\$7.80` return shipping + `\$4.50` warehouse grading (`\$12.30`) against `\$0.00` salvage value (`keepItemMaxValueAmount = \$20.00`), sets `dropOffMethod = KEEP_ITEM_NO_SHIP`, dispatches a free replacement immediately, and saves reverse freight cost and carbon.

### Journey 4: Warehouse Dock Barcode Grading -> ATP Restock vs. RTV Claim
1. Dock Operator at `#/dock-inspection` scans incoming return parcel barcode, opening `RMA-2026-4402` (2 items).
2. Item 1 (Unworn Coat with tags) is graded `GRADE_A_SELLABLE`, immediately creating an `OpsWarehouseTask` putaway to sellable `OpsInventoryPosition`. Item 2 (Faulty Espresso Grinder) is graded `RETURN_TO_VENDOR_RTV`, quarantining stock out of ATP and adding the unit to `ComVendorReturnClaim` against `OpsSupplierProfile`.

### Journey 5: Serial Mismatch / Empty-Box Fraud Quarantine via Home `WorkItem`
1. High-value headphones (`\$349.00`, expected serial `SN-884920A`) arrive at `#/dock-inspection` containing an old broken unit with mismatched serial `SN-110029X` (`serialMatched = false`, `WRONG_EMPTY_BOX_FRAUD`).
2. System immediately blocks the `ON_WAREHOUSE_INSPECTION_PASS` cash refund (`BLOCKED_FRAUD`), attaches high-res dock inspection photos, and raises a Rapider Home `WorkItem` for Loss Prevention review.

### Journey 6: BORIS In-Store Counter Return & Click-Through Filter Restoration
1. Store Associate at `#/boris-intake` scans customer's mobile QR code (or searches via `<rapider-phone-input>`), verifies unworn condition at the counter, absorbs the item into store inventory, and triggers instant exchange/refund.
2. Back-office supervisor filters `#/rmas` by `Status: "DISPUTED_FRAUD_HOLD"` (`#activeFilterTagsBar`), clicks `RMA-2026-4419` -> `#/rma-detail`, inspects dock evidence, and clicks `Back to RMAs` with filter tags preserved.

- `com.returns.authorizeReturnRequest` — Validates delivery window (`#127`), remaining line returnable qty, and policy eligibility; mints `#127` return label/QR or applies Keep-Item rule.

## 9. Security, Privacy, Compliance & Non-Functional Requirements

- **Statutory Consumer Withdrawal Compliance (EU/UK 14-Day Right of Withdrawal, Regional Laws):** Policy engine enforces statutory cooling-off periods where mandatory full refunds (without unlawful restocking fees) apply by buyer jurisdiction.
- **Blind Gift Privacy & PCI Scope Isolation:** Gift return flows strictly mask original purchaser billing details, discounts, and card digits; zero raw card PANs touch `#130` (all Instant-Exchange holds and upsell charges run via tokenized `FinPaymentIntent` in `payments`).
- **Financial Conservation & Audit Retention:** Pro-rata `Decimal128` settlement math guarantees cumulative cash refunds across partial returns never exceed original captured cash; RMA, dock photos, and credit memo links are retained for 7 years.
- **Accessibility & Responsive UX:** WCAG 2.2 AA compliant shopper portal and high-contrast warehouse/BORIS touchscreens (`#ffffff !important` primary/danger buttons) responsive across `390px` handheld scanners/phones, `768px` POS tablets, and `1440px` desktops.

## 10. Deterministic Acceptance Criteria (14 Testable Criteria)

1. **Sidebar Section Threshold:** All 3 visible sidebar sections (`Returns & Exchanges`, `Warehouse & Fraud`, `Policies & Insights`) contain >= 3 visible items (`3, 3, 3`), while `rma-detail`, `inspection-detail`, and `settlement-detail` set `displayOnMenu: false`.
2. **SWR & Clean Query Compliance:** Every page mount uses `findSWR` / `countSWR` without manual `isDeleted` filter clauses and filters `item.isDeleted !== true` defensively in memory.
3. **Active Filter Tags & Clear All:** Searching or filtering on `rmas`, `settlements-and-credits`, `fraud-and-claims`, `policies`, or `sku-return-analytics` displays `#activeFilterTagsBar` with escaped chips and working `Clear all`.
4. **Table Action & Click-Through Standard:** Zero `View` buttons exist in `Actions`; RMA `#`, Inspection `#`, and Settlement `#` navigate to detail views and `Back` restores filter state; row actions use icon+text `Edit` and icon-only `Delete`.
5. **Drawer Lifecycle & `finally` Reset:** Saving/cancelling RMA, policy, inspection, or RTV drawers auto-closes the container, resets button state in `finally`, invalidates SWR caches, and updates UI state optimistically.
6. **Over-Return Quantity Prevention:** Attempting to return `2` units on an order line of `2` where `1` unit already has an active `ComReturnLine` deterministically fails validation (`MAX_RETURNABLE_QTY_EXCEEDED`).
7. **Pro-Rata Cash Conservation & Non-Cash Bonus Guard:** Refunding an item bought with a cart discount refunds exact `Decimal128` net paid cash; `ComStoreCreditVoucher.bonusIncentiveAmount` can never be converted into a cash refund on a subsequent return.
8. **Instant Exchange Card-Hold Release on Scan:** Ingesting a `#127` return `IN_TRANSIT` event on an `INSTANT_HOLD_ACTIVE` settlement deterministically releases the `FinPaymentIntent` hold before `instantHoldDeadlineAt`.
9. **Serial Mismatch Fraud Quarantine:** Recording a `ComReturnInspection` with `serialMatched = false` or `WRONG_EMPTY_BOX_FRAUD` transitions `ComExchangeSettlement` to `BLOCKED_FRAUD` and creates a Rapider Home `WorkItem`.
10. **Grade-A Restock vs. Defective Quarantine:** Submitting `GRADE_A_SELLABLE` dispatches a sellable `OpsWarehouseTask` putaway, whereas `DEFECTIVE_REFURBISH` or `DAMAGED_SCRAP` never increments sellable ATP.
11. **Loyalty Refund vs. Exchange Event Parity:** Cash refunds emit `com.returns.refund_processed` (triggering `#129` point clawback), while even swaps emit `com.returns.exchange_completed` (zero point clawback).
12. **Custom Elements & Dialog Ban:** `<rapider-kanban>` powers the RMA lifecycle board, `<rapider-phone-input>` handles portal/BORIS phone lookup, primary/danger buttons enforce `#ffffff !important` white text, and zero `window.alert`/`confirm`/`prompt` calls exist.
13. **Dark & Light Theme Fidelity:** All 12 pages pass `validate_theme` contrast checks in dark and light themes.
14. **6-Pillar E2E Expectations Coverage:** `e2e/expectations.json` verifies all clickable actions, `findSWR`/`countSWR` reads, click-through routes, theme validation, mutation payloads, and zero runtime errors.
